item.title: Sources: Sam Altman told OpenAI staff of three AI endgames: an IAEA-style regulator, a CERN-like lab merger, or one lab using RSI to "melt everyone else's GPUs" (The Information)
item.description:
The Information:
Sources: Sam Altman told OpenAI staff of three AI endgames: an IAEA-style regulator, a CERN-like lab merger, or one lab using RSI to “melt everyone else's GPUs”  —  OpenAI CEO Sam Altman last week told employees about three proposals the industry has discussed for how to safely develop AI …

item.title: Sensor Tower: Muse had 10.9M downloads since its September debut, 10.2M of those in the US, becoming the 12th app to hit 10M US downloads in its first 40 days (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
item.description:
Sarah Perez / TechCrunch:
Sensor Tower: Muse had 10.9M downloads since its September debut, 10.2M of those in the US, becoming the 12th app to hit 10M US downloads in its first 40 days  —  Meta's AI companion, Muse, is now one of only a dozen mobile apps to have reached 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days on the market.

Original (direct link): https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/20/metas-muse-hits-10m-u-s-downloads-in-40-days-a-milestone-reached-by-only-11-other-apps/

Sources: Polymarket investors pressured CEO Shayne Coplan to add stricter financial and operational controls; Elon Musk's lawyer, Alex Spiro, joined its board  —  When Founders Fund considered investing in Polymarket in 2025, it learned that the prediction-market startup's young chief executive …

item.title: Joel Kaplan, Meta's chief global affairs officer, plans to leave in 2027 after 15+ years as Mark Zuckerberg's top DC adviser; Kaplan has close Trump ties (Mike Allen/Axios)
item.description:
Mike Allen / Axios:
Joel Kaplan, Meta's chief global affairs officer, plans to leave in 2027 after 15+ years as Mark Zuckerberg's top DC adviser; Kaplan has close Trump ties  —  Joel Kaplan, Meta's chief global affairs officer, will leave Meta next year after 15+ years as Mark Zuckerberg's top Washington adviser.

Original (direct link): https://www.axios.com/2026/10/20/joel-kaplan-meta

item.title: ASI, which makes AI tools for the military and air traffic controllers, raised a $325M Series C at a $3B valuation, after winning an $875M FAA contract in June (Bloomberg)
item.description:
Bloomberg:
ASI, which makes AI tools for the military and air traffic controllers, raised a $325M Series C at a $3B valuation, after winning an $875M FAA contract in June  —  Startup ASI raised $325 million in new funding from investors, allowing the company to expand an artificial intelligence system …

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-20/asi-hits-3-billion-valuation-in-325-million-round-led-by-spark

item.title: Daytona, which is building cloud infrastructure for AI agents, raised a $60M Series B led by FirstMark at a $1B valuation, bringing its total funding to $91M (Jeremy Kahn/Fortune)
item.description:
Jeremy Kahn / Fortune:
Daytona, which is building cloud infrastructure for AI agents, raised a $60M Series B led by FirstMark at a $1B valuation, bringing its total funding to $91M  —  AI agents need somewhere to work—and Ivan Burazin thinks the existing cloud providers aren't the right answer.

Original (direct link): https://fortune.com/2026/10/20/daytona-startup-building-the-agentic-cloud-valued-at-1-billion-in-latest-funding-round/

item.title: Firefly, whose AI software connects with existing cameras, radios, and sensors to detect incidents and coordinate real-time responses, raised a $20M Series A (Chris Metinko/Axios)
item.description:
Chris Metinko / Axios:
Firefly, whose AI software connects with existing cameras, radios, and sensors to detect incidents and coordinate real-time responses, raised a $20M Series A  —  Firefly, a physical AI safety startup, emerged from stealth with a $20 million Series A led by Definition Capital, CEO James Batt Buckley tells Axios Pro exclusively.

Original (direct link): https://www.axios.com/pro/enterprise-software-deals/2026/10/20/safety-software-ai-firefly

item.title: Sources: OpenAI has retreated from advocating for strict export controls on US chipmakers selling to China, a boon for Nvidia and aligning with President Trump (Politico)
item.description:
Politico:
Sources: OpenAI has retreated from advocating for strict export controls on US chipmakers selling to China, a boon for Nvidia and aligning with President Trump  —  OpenAI has changed its tune on China.  Nvidia is a big winner.  —  OpenAI for much of last year advocated for strict limits …

Original (direct link): https://www.politico.com/news/2026/10/20/openai-ai-chips-china-nvidia-01127385

item.title: TikTok staff depositions: TikTok executives ignored internal warnings about child sexual exploitation on Live, where staff said minors appeared in livestreams (Katie McQue/NPR)
item.description:
Katie McQue / NPR:
TikTok staff depositions: TikTok executives ignored internal warnings about child sexual exploitation on Live, where staff said minors appeared in livestreams  —  TikTok employees repeatedly raised concerns internally about the risks the short-form video app posed to children …

item.title: Arda, which builds AI software and agents to accelerate assembly lines and manufacturing, raised $230M at a $1.5B valuation led by Altimeter, Accel, and Khosla (Kate Rooney/CNBC)
item.description:
Kate Rooney / CNBC:
Arda, which builds AI software and agents to accelerate assembly lines and manufacturing, raised $230M at a $1.5B valuation led by Altimeter, Accel, and Khosla  —  OpenAI's former research chief has been quietly building a startup that aims to bring manufacturing back to the U.S. using AI.

Original (direct link): https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/20/ex-openai-executive-builds-1point5-billion-ai-manufacturing-startup-arda.html

item.title: Eka Robotics, which is developing a "vision-force-action" architecture for its physical AI models, raised a $150M Series A at a $1.45B post-money valuation (Tim Fernholz/TechCrunch)
item.description:
Tim Fernholz / TechCrunch:
Eka Robotics, which is developing a “vision-force-action” architecture for its physical AI models, raised a $150M Series A at a $1.45B post-money valuation  —  Robots still aren't that good at picking things up, despite billions of dollars of investment and endless videos fed into deep learning models.

Original (direct link): https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/20/eka-is-worth-1-45-billion-thanks-to-a-physical-ai-model-that-has-experts-raving/

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer, its high-performance inference framework that powers its production services, starting with support for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (Saritha Rai/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Saritha Rai / Bloomberg:
DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer, its high-performance inference framework that powers its production services, starting with support for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash  —  DeepSeek is opening up the software it uses to run its artificial intelligence models at scale, potentially making its technology cheaper and easier for businesses to run.

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-20/deepseek-unveils-open-source-tool-to-help-cut-ai-operating-costs

item.title: Salesforce agrees to acquire AI-powered marketing platform Braze for nearly $5.7B in enterprise value, paying $47.50 per share, set to close from February 2027 (Dana Wollman/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Dana Wollman / Bloomberg:
Salesforce agrees to acquire AI-powered marketing platform Braze for nearly $5.7B in enterprise value, paying $47.50 per share, set to close from February 2027  —  Salesforce Inc. has agreed to buy Braze Inc., an artificial intelligence-powered platform for marketers, for almost $5.7 billion in enterprise value.

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-20/salesforce-to-buy-marketing-platform-braze-for-5-7-billion

item.title: Spotify launches paid podcast memberships in 34 markets, including the US; creators can offer perks like bonus content or fewer ads and keep 90% of revenue (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
item.description:
Sarah Perez / TechCrunch:
Spotify launches paid podcast memberships in 34 markets, including the US; creators can offer perks like bonus content or fewer ads and keep 90% of revenue  —  Spotify on Tuesday launched paid memberships, a new way for podcasters to make money from their biggest fans beyond paywalled bonus episodes.

Original (direct link): https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/20/spotify-launches-paid-podcast-memberships-with-perks-beyond-bonus-content/

item.title: Apple says it will commit up to $100M over three years to Pennsylvania-based Perryman, a titanium supplier for the iPhone Duo, and expand its Qnity partnership (MacKenzie Sigalos/CNBC)
item.description:

Apple says it will commit up to $100M over three years to Pennsylvania-based Perryman, a titanium supplier for the iPhone Duo, and expand its Qnity partnership  —  Apple is adding a U.S. titanium supplier for its new iPhone Duo and expanding domestic production of camera components …

Original (direct link): https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/20/apple-adds-us-titanium-supplier-for-iphone-duo.html
